title: Symbiote’s Song
description:
Hello, victim!
I’ve got another one of my more spooky files, but less so than my previous ones. This one is more science fiction than horror, with a lot more potential. There is an abandoned, derelict spaceship, there is you, and then there is a symbiotic alien creature whose tastes are quite exotic. Oh, there is also a wormhole.
If you’d like to skip all spoilers, now is a good time to skip all spoilers and just listen.
